submitted.rationale: Mg-Sb oxides absorb 3.2 eV light only when they are Sb-rich, with Sb3+ or mixed-valence Sb (Sb2O4/MgSb2O4-like). The Mg-rich phases (MgO, Mg-rich antimonates) have gaps that are too wide. Measured EQE rose from 0.0025% at index 20 (Sb 0.58) to 0.0176% at index 25 (Sb 0.73). It then dipped slightly to 0.0147% at index 26 (Sb 0.76), so the peak is at or near index 25.

rejected.reason: MgO and Mg-rich antimonates have wide band gaps, well above 3.2 eV, and EQE fell as Mg increased
